{{Top|leg}}
'''Senflax''' was a potent neurotoxin that was the product of a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] only found within the jungles of [[Cadannia]]. It was a pale [[Color/Legends|yellow]] liquid that was primarily used as a sedative which allowed an individual to remain conscious while simultaneously numbing all physical sensation. It induced paralysis in the body's primary muscles, though it had no effect on vital organs regardless of the administered dosage. Senflax also interrupted an individual's mental capacities, disrupting the concentration required to manipulate [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Ambria/Legends|Ambrian]] [[Force healing/Legends|healer]] [[Caleb]] kept a supply of Senflax among his many other natural herbs and remedies within the cellar of his shack. His daughter [[Serra]] recovered it [[980 BBY|ten years]] after Caleb's [[Death/Legends|death]], and furnished the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Darth Cognus|Huntress]] with it in the quest to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|apprehend]] Serra's enemy, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. A Sith who was ready could burn away the poison with the fire of Bogan, but without being aware even Bane himself was felled and captured.<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>
